tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq October mein Nasdaq 100 se $2 trillion se zyada market value khatam ho gayi, index 5.8% se zyada gira. Meta, Alphabet aur Amazon ne AI infrastructure par kharch ke forecasts aur barha diye, to investors ko shak hua ke itni bari investment ka return kab aayega. Alphabet ka ek din mein record percentage drop bhi isi daur mein aaya.
tech.title: AI ka bill ab market ko bhaari par raha — Nasdaq 100 se October mein $2 trillion saaf

tech.summary: OpenAI aur Anthropic ne 26 October ko alag alag daawa kiya ke un ke internal AI models ne Exponential Time Hypothesis ko ghalat sabit kar diya — dono ne core algorithm 16 October ko paane ka daawa kiya aur Lean 4 mein machine-checked proofs diye. Agar review mein ye sabit ho gaya, to 800 se zyada papers jin ki bunyaad ETH par thi, dobara dekhne parenge. Ye P vs NP ka hal NAHI hai, aur reviewers ne abhi certify nahi kiya.
tech.title: Do AI labs ne ek hi din mein 27 saal purana maths assumption gira diya — ETH false?

tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq US Department of Justice pooch raha hai ke Nvidia ka $12.93 billion mein Hugging Face khareedna AI competition ko nuqsan to nahi pohanchayega — kyun ke Hugging Face open AI models ka sab se bara hub hai. Deal September mein announce hui thi aur 2027 ki pehli half mein close hone ki umeed hai. Inquiry ka matlab ghalat kaam sabit hona nahi hai.
tech.title: Nvidia ke $12.9B Hugging Face deal par US Justice Department ki nazar

tech.summary: Google ke Project Suncatcher ke prototype satellite ne 30 October ko orbit mein TPU par generative AI model chalaya: Gemma 4 ne space par haiku likha aur jawab ground station tak pohanchaya. Google isay data-center-class TPU ka pehla orbit response kehta hai, lekin ye abhi sirf 'Hello World' stage hai — radiation, cooling aur lambi reliability abhi prove honi baqi hai, aur 2027 mein do satellites ka experiment planned hai.
tech.title: Google ne AI chip khala mein chala di — TPU orbit mein Gemma 4 se haiku likh aaya

tech.summary: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ke mutabiq Claude Opus 5.5 abhi bhi 58 score ke saath pehle number par hai, lekin October mein poora top-5 Anthropic ka tha — ab Meta ka Muse Wonder Full 56 par fourth aur Moonshot ka Kimi K3.1 Pro 55 par fifth aa gaya hai, jo is board par pehla non-US model hai top-5 mein. Muse Wonder 162 tokens/sec ke saath top-15 mein sab se tez bhi hai.
tech.title: November AI rankings: Claude abhi bhi #1, lekin top-5 ka sweep toot gaya

tech.summary: Profound ne 2 November ko Singapore mein apna Asia-Pacific headquarters banane ka elan kiya — regional leadership, go-to-market aur customer teams wahin se Southeast Asia, Japan, Australia aur New Zealand ko serve karengi. Company ke mutabiq Singapore ki 61% abadi AI tools use karti hai, aur ChatGPT/Gemini par khareedne ki research wali conversations January se September tak 23% barhi hain.
tech.title: AI marketing platform Profound ne Singapore ko Asia-Pacific HQ bana liya

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Sunday ko Group of 24 (G-24) ki chairmanship sambhal li. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb ne kaha ke Pakistan developing economies ki collective awaz mazboot karega aur 'more responsive, fair and development-oriented' international financial system ke liye kaam karega. Un ki teen priorities: development ko policymaking ke centre mein rakhna, multilateral frameworks mazboot karna, aur development-oriented financial architecture.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne G-24 ki chairmanship sambhal li — developing countries ki awaz ab Islamabad ke haath

pakistan.summary: September 2026 mein Pakistan ne 420,000 tonnes chawal export kiye, jab ke Vietnam ke 337,000 tonnes rahe — aur Pakistani exporters ko $621 per tonne mila jab ke Vietnam ko $563. Dawn ke mutabiq July-September quarter mein total rice export volumes 51% barhe aur foreign exchange earnings 37% barhi, Gulf shipping disruptions ke bawajood.
pakistan.title: Basmati ka kamal: Pakistan ne September mein rice exports mein Vietnam ko peeche chhor diya

pakistan.summary: Punjab Emergency Operations Centre aaj 2 November se 13 districts mein polio eradication campaign shuru kar raha hai, jis mein 5 saal se kam umar ke 9.3 million se zyada bachon ko vaccinate kiya jayega. 77,000 se zyada frontline workers ghar ghar jayenge; Lahore mein campaign 7 din aur baqi 12 districts mein 4 din chalegi.
pakistan.title: Punjab mein aaj se polio campaign — 13 districts mein 9.3 million bachon ko drops

pakistan.summary: Deputy PM aur Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar aur Maldivian Foreign Minister Iruthisham Adam ke darmiyan telephone conversation mein dono mulkon ne bilateral relations aur cooperation ko mazeed mazboot karne par ittefaq kiya. Maldivian FM ne President Mohamed Muizzu ke recent Islamabad visit par Pakistan ki mezbani ki tareef ki, aur dono ne Commonwealth meeting ke agenda par bhi baat ki.
pakistan.title: Pakistan aur Maldives ne bilateral cooperation aur mazboot karne ka azm dohraya

pakistan.summary: Business Recorder ke mutabiq security forces ne Afghan Taliban border posts ki taraf se unprovoked firing ka jawab dete hue un posts ko target kiya. Report mein firing Pakistani positions ko target karne ki baat ki gayi hai; mazeed tafseelat report mein mukhtasar hain.
pakistan.title: Border par firing ke baad security forces ne Taliban posts ko nishana banaya

pakistan.summary: Asia Web3 Alliance Japan ki President Hinza Asif ne kaha hai ke Pakistan ko ek unified crypto industry body chahiye jo digital asset investors ko safeguard kare aur international exchanges ke saath coordination behtar banaye — ye tajweez Binance se mutaliq recent multibillion-dollar cybersecurity breach ke baad aayi hai. Unhon ne kaha ke Pakistan crypto adoption mein teesre number par hai, lekin investors ki numaindagi ka koi organised mechanism nahi.
pakistan.title: Binance breach ke baad Pakistan mein unified crypto industry body ki tajweez
